messages:
Priya (CS): quick midweek pulse for MerchantCo — tokens + throughput snapshot. TL;DR: tokens/day ~1.2M (+8% WoW, +18% QoQ), avg latency p50 210ms (flat), p95 890ms (+12ms WoW), error rate 0.6% (was 0.4%), spend ~$3.4k/day (+5% WoW). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/merchantco/health

Marco (CSE): nice ramp. any new prompt sets or long chats causing the error uptick? :thinking_face:

Priya (CS): correlation with a handful of long-chat sessions — requests >3k tokens. saw error cluster around seq_len >3000 (timeout / OOM-ish). quick query i ran:```
SELECT hour_bin, count(*) as failures
FROM request_logs
WHERE account='merchantco' AND status!='ok' AND seq_len>3000
GROUP BY hour_bin
ORDER BY hour_bin DESC
LIMIT 48;```

Marco (CSE): thx — seems like we should try conservative throttling + kv cache for those flows. i'll prototype a max_seq policy + quantization fallback.

Tariq (Account): heads-up — renewal conversation Q3. overall spend is up, but two of their product teams haven't adopted the new SDK. risk = medium if latency keeps spiking.

Priya (CS): noted. tagging as renewal-watch. plan: 1) enablement outreach for the 2 teams, 2) short-term infra mitigations, 3) regression checks on prompt set. @Marco can you take enablement sync + sample prompts?

cs-bot: Alert: p95 latency >800ms detected for account MerchantCo for 4h (2026-03-20T10:12Z → 2026-03-20T14:15Z).

Ben (eng-sre): digging in — saw GPU pool us-west-2 at ~98% during the window. autoscale didn't add nodes: hit quota for gpus-per-tenant. opened INF-4721 to request temporary quota bump.

Marco (CSE): ok i'll push a conservative quant profile to their dedicated variant and enable per-request kv caching for long sessions. should drop p95 by ~150–250ms in staging. testing now. ETA Thu EOD.

Priya (CS): action items:
- Marco: quant+kv quick patch (test on staging) — ETA Thu
- Ben/eng-sre: follow up on INF-4721 and confirm autoscale rules / quotas — please share ETA
- Priya/Tariq: schedule enablement for the two product teams next week (30/45 min playbook + regen tests)

Tariq (Account): appreciated. if Marco can cut p95 by ~200ms before our renewal touch we'll highlight perf improvements in QBR.

Priya (CS): i'll post a short follow-up on Friday with updated tokens/day, p95, error rate, and spend delta. attaching a tiny prompt set for regression checks in the meantime. :white_check_mark:

Marco (CSE): ack — will post results and sample logs here.

Ben (eng-sre): will update INF-4721 with timeline and reach out if we need manual scaling.

Priya (CS): thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for the midweek ramp watch.
